# topopt-binary-cantilever-80x50-v0.5-k3: our design for minimum feature size 2 at volume 0.4 with every element grown into the 3 x 3 square around it, repaired, trimmed to the volume by strip removals, local search of strip and single-element moves
# QV-Topo 1 (a numerical model); checker args: compliance cantilever 80 50 0.5 binary 3
